title: Astragalus Polysaccharide Enhances O-GlcNAcylation Through OGT to Improve Intervertebral Disc Degeneration in Rats.
authors: Tan, Hao; Fang, Cao; Tan, Yiyun; Wang, Zhi; Zhou, Yun; Li, Xing
journal: Journal of cellular and molecular medicine
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄芪多糖通过OGT增强O-GlcNAcylation稳定Nrf2改善椎间盘退变，虽含分子对接但核心为细胞与动物实验，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: Astragalus polysaccharides (APS) are a crucial bioactive component known for their various pharmacological properties. Abnormal O-linked beta-N-acetylglucosamine modification (O-GlcNAcylation) is noted in cases of intervertebral disc degeneration (IVDD). Nonetheless, it remains uncertain whether APS regulates the process of O-GlcNAcylation associated with IVDD. We employed molecular docking, cycloheximide chase assay, immunohistochemistry, and immunoprecipitation to investigate APS-mediated OGT/O-GlcNAcylation regulation of Nrf2. The effects of APS and its role in promoting the O-GlcNAcylation of Nrf2 in IVDD through both in vivo and in vitro studies are discussed. In vitro investigations demonstrated an increase in the levels of OGT and O-GlcNAcylation in nucleus pulposus cells (NPCs) following exposure to tert-butyl hydroperoxide (TBHP). APS further facilitated improvements in OGT expression and O-GlcNAcylation processes, restoring the viability of NPCs inhibited by TBHP and promoting the synthesis of collagen II and aggrecan, while reducing apoptosis. Mechanistically, APS promotes the expression of OGT by targeting it. Furthermore, O-GlcNAcylation mediated by OGT stabilizes the expression of Nrf2 via the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway. Rescue experiments indicated that the disruption of either OGT or Nrf2 expression negated the protective role of APS on NPCs. Ultimately, both in vitro and in vivo studies indicated that APS significantly enhanced OGT expression and O-GlcNAcylation, which subsequently improved Nrf2 expression and contributed to the alleviation of IVDD in rats. APS promotes O-GlcNAcylation through OGT, thereby stabilizing the expression of Nrf2, which in turn contributes to the improvement of IVDD.
abstract_zh: 黄芪多糖（Astragalus polysaccharides, APS）是一种关键的生物活性成分，以其多种药理特性而闻名。在椎间盘退变（intervertebral disc degeneration, IVDD）病例中，观察到异常的O-连接β-N-乙酰氨基葡萄糖修饰（O-GlcNAcylation）。然而，APS是否调节与IVDD相关的O-GlcNAcylation过程仍不确定。我们采用分子对接、放线菌酮追踪实验、免疫组织化学和免疫沉淀法来研究APS介导的OGT/O-GlcNAcylation对Nrf2的调控。通过体内和体外研究，探讨了APS的作用及其在IVDD中促进Nrf2 O-GlcNAcylation的机制。体外研究表明，在叔丁基过氧化氢（tert-butyl hydroperoxide, TBHP）暴露后，髓核细胞（nucleus pulposus cells, NPCs）中OGT和O-GlcNAcylation水平升高。APS进一步促进了OGT表达和O-GlcNAcylation过程的改善，恢复了受TBHP抑制的NPCs的活力，并促进了胶原蛋白II和聚集蛋白聚糖的合成，同时减少了细胞凋亡。机制上，APS通过靶向OGT促进其表达。此外，OGT介导的O-GlcNAcylation通过泛素-蛋白酶体途径稳定Nrf2的表达。救援实验表明，OGT或Nrf2表达的破坏抵消了APS对NPCs的保护作用。最终，体外和体内研究均表明，APS显著增强了OGT表达和O-GlcNAcylation，进而改善了Nrf2表达，并有助于缓解大鼠IVDD。APS通过OGT促进O-GlcNAcylation，从而稳定Nrf2的表达，进而有助于改善IVDD。
